name: bromonordiazepam
summary: Bromonordiazepam, also known as desalkylgidazepam, is a benzodiazepine derivative which has been sold as a designer drug. It is structurally similar to diazepam, and its analogue nordazepam, but exchanges a chloro group at position 7 for a bromine substitution. It is the active metabolite of gidazepam, but has appeared in the illicit drug market alone.

sideEffects.en: It is reported to act for a very long time, so effects can build up with repeated taking. Benzodiazepines cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems, and regular use leads to dependence, with withdrawal that can include seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 據報告它的作用時間極長，因此重複服用時效果可能累積。苯二氮平類會造成嗜睡、協調變差與記憶問題，規律使用會導致依賴，戒斷時可能出現癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 据报告它的作用时间极长，因此重复服用时效果可能累积。苯二氮平类会造成嗜睡、协调制差与记忆问题，规律使用会导致依赖，戒断时可能出现癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is the active breakdown product of gidazepam, a benzodiazepine developed in the Soviet Union. It has since been sold on its own as a designer drug under the name desalkylgidazepam.
fact.zh: 它是蘇聯開發的苯二氮平類藥物 gidazepam 的活性代謝產物。後來它以 desalkylgidazepam 之名單獨作為設計師藥物販售。
fact.zhHans: 它是苏联开发的苯二氮平类药物 gidazepam 的活性代谢产物。后来它以 desalkylgidazepam 之名单独作为设计师药物贩售。
